facts.text: The scenario catalog should be encoded in a domain-neutral, version-controlled form, using Scenic or an in-house YAML schema with an OpenODD-style taxonomy.
facts.quote: Encode the catalog in a domain-neutral, version-controlled form: Scenic, or an in-house YAML schema with an OpenODD-style taxonomy

facts.text: The manufacturer should own and govern the domain-neutral, version-controlled scenario catalog.
facts.quote: owned and governed by the manufacturer

facts.text: Scenario behaviour should be represented using a parameterised scenario DSL or an equivalent internal schema.
facts.quote: Use a parameterised scenario DSL or equivalent internal schema for behaviour

facts.text: Site geometry should use suitable 3D terrain and material formats, including OpenMATERIAL 3D where it helps.
facts.quote: suitable 3D terrain and material formats for site geometry (OpenMATERIAL 3D where it helps)

facts.text: OpenDRIVE should be used for structured haul-road elements where useful.
facts.quote: OpenDRIVE for structured haul-road elements where useful

facts.text: Sensor and model interfaces should use OSI and FMI/SSP, with adapter layers to simulation, HIL and physical automation.
facts.quote: OSI and FMI/SSP for sensor and model interfaces, with adapter layers to simulation, HIL and physical automation

facts.text: The scenario catalog should be exported to OpenSCENARIO for tools that require OpenSCENARIO.
facts.quote: Export to OpenSCENARIO for tools that need it.

facts.text: Off-road scenario-standard planning should not depend on an off-road standard arriving before mid-2027.
facts.quote: Do not bet on an off-road standard arriving before mid-2027

facts.text: No off-road scenario standard in development was found that could arrive before mid-2027.
facts.quote: Do not bet on an off-road standard arriving before mid-2027; none was found in development that could.
